name: Brantley
gaps: Parcels are Brantley_Parcels view (county AGOL / bcgis100) (https://services3.arcgis.com/86pyA5PND5NdokIc/arcgis/rest/services/Brantley_Parcels_view/FeatureServer/0). Published acreage is filtered to 5.0–150.0 inclusive. No Opportunity Zone status, school grade, or base flood elevation is stored.

Pass 2 sale is HTML-only. Zero-filled SALE_VAL columns are not stored as a sale price, and qPublic was not requested.
Property-appraiser links are filled from the pass-2 template with each parcel id and were not requested. Owner phone and email are not ingested.
